summary: RETEST PASSED on 390x844 mobile viewport. All 3 iteration-1 bugs fixed and verified end-to-end: (1) autocomplete-bar NOW appears after typing '\nco' into sample.js with suggestion-console/suggestion-const/suggestion-constructor present; tapping suggestion-console inserts 'console' at the caret (caret estimation via text diff in onChangeText works). (2) editor-more-btn -> more-history closes the editor-more-sheet (MORE_SHEET_VISIBLE=False after navigation) and lands on history-screen cleanly - the 300ms delay successfully dismisses the modal before router.push. (3) 'My first commit' entered via commit-sheet-input and committed via commit-sheet-confirm shows as the top version row label (not 'Autosave'); same for history-commit-btn -> 'Second named commit' top row. Sheet confirm buttons for commit-sheet and history-commit-sheet are now reachable with a NORMAL (non-force) click at 390x844 (bbox y=780 h=48, bottom=828 within 844). Confirm buttons are disabled when input is empty (Button prop + visual opacity 0.5) and enable after typing. Quick regression all green: home list (2 files), autosave status 'Saved · Auto: JavaScript', find-count 1/2 for 'greet', check-screen offline shows score 96 with 1 code issue (no network errors). No red screen, no console errors observed.

react_native_issues.issue: Button does not forward disabled state via accessibilityState, so DOM aria-disabled is not set. Visually it dims (opacity 0.5) and Pressable blocks onPress, but screen readers / Playwright is_disabled() report false. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:60-69. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: pass accessibilityState={{disabled}} on the Button Pressable so assistive tech / tests can detect disabled state.
Earlier non-blocking: react-native-web warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' still present (from a dep).
critical_code_review_comments: store.tsx addVersion is now serialized via verQueue (Promise chain) which fixes the race between autosave and named commit - good fix.
store.tsx line 267: autosave with identical content is promoted to named commit (list[0] = {...v, id: last.id}) - matches expected behavior.
editor.tsx goTo adds 300ms delay only when the sheet was open, preserving instant nav when invoked elsewhere - clean.
editor.tsx onChangeText now computes caret from text diff (common-suffix), fixing autocomplete prefix detection when selectionChange hasn't fired yet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported frontend bugs from iteration_1 are fixed. Sheet confirm buttons are now within viewport at 390x844 (bbox y=780, visible). addVersion is now Promise-queued in /app/frontend/src/lib/store.tsx (verQueue). Autocomplete requires text to end with a word prefix of length>=2 - verified working after fill(). To open sample.js from home, iterate [data-testid^='file-row-'] and match text 'sample'.
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration root causes (now fixed): (a) autocomplete missed because selectionChange lagged behind onChangeText - resolved by computing caret in onChangeText via common-suffix diff; (b) more-history ghost overlay - resolved by setMoreOpen(false) then setTimeout(push, 300); (c) commit label lost - resolved by Promise-serialized addVersion queue + autosave->named promotion when content unchanged.
